authority: 2026-11-16 user: implement and execute bounded pilots; main only after design gates

definitions.M: distinct demand instances; nested scales are not independent families
definitions.R_a: fresh independently initialized whole-plan attempts of method a; failures count
definitions.tau: comparison parent wall including input, initialization, assignment, routing, trip connections, loading, all branch collection and final dual validation
definitions.internal: shots, optimizer evaluations, pricing rounds, restarts and four parallel multistarts belong inside one attempt

primary.scope: fixed frozen S2 demand; method-specific successful-attempt mean difference D minus C, feasibility co-reported
primary.power: not a required input to precision design; prior 0.80 retained only for possible future power design
primary.multiplicity: one primary contrast/metric/scale; auxiliary pointwise 95% intervals are exploratory; promote only with new preregistration and Holm family

auxiliary.target: accepted plan D<=frozen A D and W<=frozen A W; computational research target, not operational requirement
auxiliary.target_source: pre-existing comparison_integration_v1_20261115_A_checks02/ALL_RESULTS.json; frozen A, not fitted to new outcomes
auxiliary.J: unchanged (D/D_A + W/W_A + T/T_A_ref)/3; all preregistered A time members median, all must succeed and agree; zero denominator -> null reason

selection.rule: first (smallest common wall budget) profile with every scale/method attempt adoptable and at least one completed D quantum call per scale; otherwise largest is provisional and main HOLD
selection.basis: qualification and lower computational ceiling, not observed winning method or difference size
selection.tuning_opportunities: same two whole-method candidate budgets for all methods; A frozen; B has no exposed internal search parameter; C and D each receive two preset internal effort levels
selection.quality_tradeoff: both candidates measured independently; this rule does not certify best quality or convergence
selection.reason: routing fractions, stage allocations, validation reserves and pricing stopping depend on the initially supplied budget

pilot.memory_enforcement: sampled process-tree RSS sum at 0.5s; conservative shared-page sum; transient peaks may be missed; frozen A intrinsic 4096MiB remains
pilot.addition_rule: no additional batches in this experiment ID; missing variance/qualification -> HOLD; new registered pilot required
pilot.execution: one method attempt at a time; B/C/D/control four distinct physical cores, one native thread per branch; A one worker; randomized order per batch
pilot.environment: existing ad-pipeline-v1 interpreter, existing local /opt/qgpu dependency directory searched first; numpy2.3.1 scipy1.16.0 qiskit2.1.1 ortools9.14.6206 unchanged; path ordering and import file hashes saved; all fresh child imports remain inside T
pilot.budget_meaning: research comparison computational ceiling; no evidence of an operational deadline

main.generalization: not adopted; additional M scenarios are sensitivity assumptions only, no demand generation
main.stopping: fixed preregistered attempt list including failures; no significance or CI-width dependent extension
main.safety_stop: resource violation, code/input/config mismatch, owned child cleanup failure -> abort remaining runs, preserve NOT_STARTED; no replacement
decision_required: total main wall-cost ceiling; auxiliary scales/precision requirements
main.inference: independent Welch per fixed input; same repeat/seed index is not a pair; demand analysis uses per-demand method means paired by independent family
main.variance_sensitivity: point estimate plus normal-model chi-square upper variance; observed zero stochastic variance remains unidentified; conditional-quality cost is optimistic under failures
main.rate_design: worst-case Wilson precision, even with all-success pilot; report exact Clopper-Pearson failure upper bounds
main.future_generalization: subtract within-mean sampling variance once for between-demand moment estimate; demand-level t CI uses observed demand mean differences without adding within noise twice
